root_review.basis: Source reset writes 25 two-word slots; source copy moves 50 words; all four driver dispatch tables have 25 far pointers. All 23 registered views join to 4-byte slots within one typed near array. Clean MSC-startup fixtures verify all slots, source-shaped copy/reset and shifted-layout offset+segment pointer relocation on both linkers, with wrong last alias, nonzero owner and pointer+4 contrasts. Canonical m1B4E pointer is already symbolic and needs no source edit.
root_review.production_context: The data-only provider uses /AL /Os /Gs without debug emission. The build verifies the exact single near COMDEF extent, zero initialized/code bytes, zero publics and fixups and no other externals. The test provider uses /Zi; only debug metadata and type indices differ, not storage extent or pointer representation.
root_review.limits: Original COMDEF TU/order/padding, wider SS/ES frame dependencies and whole-game physical-driver integration remain unclaimed.
root_review.original_startup: Accepted MSC startup clears [DGROUP:8B9E,94F0) before main. The source-access-derived callback array [9128,918C) is fully inside it. Runtime fixtures verify the equivalent near-communal zero initialization under both independently laid out linkers.
root_review.reproducer_output: The probe writes candidate contracts only to ignored scratch; it never rewrites an admitted packet. The rerun after relocating that output preserves all eight runtime outcomes.
